item.description:

Why it is here: News of a campus closure, with some useful details but less relevant to the reader's interests.

The Minnesota State Community and Technical College plans to close its Detroit Lakes campus in 2028 due to dwindling enrollment and costly maintenance. The closure, approved by the Board of Trustees, aims to save $1 million annually and $18 million in future investments. The campus, despite its size, has only 111 students and requires extensive repairs.
